custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 4.8 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
  • A cycle count is running when the Inventory list shows a Count column with Save and Cancel above it; click Cancel to stop it.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu lists Cycle count, Deactivate parts and Export.

Step 2:

  • The dark bar appears under the tabs and a checkbox column appears in the list.

Step 3:

  • The menu opens just below the three-dot button with one entry only: Export.
  • The dark bar stays in place above the toolbar while the menu is open.

Step 4:

  • The menu closes; the dark bar is still shown.

Step 5:

  • The dark bar and the checkbox column disappear.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R10b: “While the mode is on, the actions menu offers only Export. Cycle count and the bulk entry come back when the mode ends.”
  • S2-R9a: “The X leaves the mode, clears the selection and puts the toolbar back to its normal state.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
